targets.mini-stay-security: mini-stay authorization boundaries -- no/wrong/forged token, role confusion, cross-guest access (be/api)
targets.mini-stay-fe: mini-stay HTML pages -- hotels, rooms, a booking, a guest's bookings and admin overview (Playwright)
targets.frankfurter-api: frankfurter.dev public FX API (no key) -- historical-rate equality and latest shape, used to convert a stay price
